# Independent column-order PDF fixtures

Original authored test material generated by `generate.py` using ReportLab 4.4.9, invariant PDF IDs, uncompressed streams and standard Helvetica. No application code or PDF.js is used to construct the PDFs or expected text. These fixtures may be distributed with the project.

Regenerate with a Python environment containing ReportLab 4.4.9:

```
python3 test/fixtures/pdf-page-columns/generate.py
```

- `row-major.pdf` and `column-major.pdf` contain identical text at identical coordinates. Their drawing stream orders differ. Both contain a heading and footer spanning the two text columns.
- `changed-word.pdf` changes only the middle right-column line to `Right changed`.
- `multi-band.pdf` adds a spanning middle heading and a second two-column band. Each band must read left column then right column, without moving the middle heading or footer into either column.
- `expected.json` records independently authored expected text and generator version. The expected sequence follows the deliberate document layout, not text returned by the implementation.

These fixtures qualify a narrow explicit horizontal-LTR geometric policy. They do not establish arbitrary document reading-order inference, table structure reconstruction or visual equivalence.
